paper_number: Sec. S9 (GPUs and compute time), prose
caption: Every experiment runs on one node with NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs of 24 GB each, two AMD EPYC 7763 processors totaling 128 physical cores, and 2 TB of RAM.
note: Section S9 has no table; it states ranges in prose. `published` here is the range the paper prints and `per_entry` the four measurements it is taken from. Every stage of the pipeline occupies a single GPU. The node has eight GPUs, but the paper deliberately omits the count because no experiment used more than one at a time. The RAM figure is nominal: the machine reports MemTotal 2,113,592,592 kB, which is 1.9684 TiB, and the GPUs are written as 24 GB in the same nominal style. This section carries no resolution, so the EMPIAR-10345 pixel-size caveat does not apply to it. Timings are wall clock on a contended cluster and are indicative rather than reproducible to the second.

provenance.source: supp.tex, section sec:supp:cost; docs/notes/supp.md, heading sec:supp:cost and the section-level note dated 2026-08-21; raw measurements in data/revision/cost.json (copied to revision/cost.json)
provenance.detail: The hardware description was checked against the machine on 2026-08-23. cost.json was verified against its original on 2026-08-24, with one field edited on purpose: hardware.total_memory, which had recorded the TiB value under a decimal prefix.

apply_cached_masks_full_set.published_form: at most 75 seconds for an entire set

reconstruction_arm_full_set.published_form: one reconstruction arm of three ab-initio runs and three refinements

finetuning_round.basis: EMPIAR-10081 on an uncontended GPU. The teacher set is 50 micrographs on every entry, so the cost does not vary with the dataset. cost.json records the wall clock of every round; rounds that shared their GPU with other work took longer, and those contended measurements are not what the paper reports.

not_in_paper.note: Per-round loop timings and the three refinement jobs of the fb condition per entry, from revision/cost.json. Round 3 of EMPIAR-10345 records finetune_s as 0, which means the value was not captured rather than that the round was free.
